name: Memphis v5 Landing Rebuild
description: Build a public-facing HTML landing page in the memphis-v5.pl design vocabulary — Memphis orange, MiniMax blue, Watra earth, three-brand integration theme, hero stats grid, two-column comparison, diagram, pricing cards, partnership strip, CTA. Use when a pitch deck needs a single-page public version, or when a sub-brand must keep the visual family.
workflow: READ THE TOKENS: take the CSS custom properties from the skill document — they are the canonical values for every landing in this family.
DERIVE: read the reference pitch deck at docs/pitch/memphis-watra-minimax-pitch-deck.html for the light-mode canvas and docs/pitch/memphis-v5-pl-landing.html for the dark-mode adaptation.
BUILD: produce one self-contained HTML file with the hero stats grid, the two-column comparison, the diagram section, the pricing cards, the partnership strip and the CTA — in that order.
VERIFY: render the page locally and check the tokens against the reference before publishing.
promptHints: Do NOT use this skill for internal admin docs under docs/ (different layout), for PDF-only deliverables (use libreoffice --convert-to pdf) or for marketing email templates (single-column).
All pages in this family use the exact token values unless a deviation is documented.
The deploy target is a webroot on a shared host reached over SSH — that is the remote-site-edit skill, not this one.

examples.prompt: Zrób landing w stylu memphis-v5.pl dla Watra.ai
examples.outcome: The skill supplies the design tokens and the section order, the reference decks supply the visual vocabulary, and the result is a single self-contained HTML page.

notes: Tier 0: read and write under the user's own paths, no vault and no passphrase.
The reference decks and the published site are the source of truth for the visual family; the skill only records the vocabulary so it does not have to be rediscovered each time.
